args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Versions
<2.9.4 on the 2.x line are affected; 2.9.4 is the fix release.
Staying on the 2.x line to avoid a major-version upgrade to 3.x.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. All 2.x versions <2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 is the fix release.

The upgrade stays on the 2.x line (rather than bumping to 3.x) to minimize compatibility risk. No code changes were required — only the pinned version in `requirements.txt`.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**
